## Packages

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(tidyr)
```

## ARCEP fibre

```{r}
fibre <- read_excel("data/2026t2-obs-hd-thd-deploiement-vf.xlsx",
                    sheet = "Communes", skip = 4, col_types = "text")
write_csv(fibre, "data/arcep_fibre_communes.csv")
dim(fibre)
```

## COG

```{r}
cog <- read_excel("data/table_passage_annuelle_2026.xlsx",
                  skip = 5, col_types = "text")
write_csv(cog, "data/cog_table_passage_2026.csv")
head(cog)
```

## Census 2017

```{r}
rp <- read_delim("data/base-cc-emploi-pop-active-2017.CSV",
                 delim = ";", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
rp2017 <- rp |>
  select(CODGEO, starts_with("C17_ACTOCC1564"))
write_csv(rp2017, "data/rp2017_emploi_commune.csv")
head(rp2017)
```

## SIRENE

```{r}
sirene <- open_dataset("data/stock-stocketablissement-parquet.parquet") |>
  select(codeCommuneEtablissement, dateCreationEtablissement) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(substr(as.character(dateCreationEtablissement), 1, 4))) |>
  filter(year >= 2014, !is.na(codeCommuneEtablissement)) |>
  count(codeCommuneEtablissement, year, name = "n_creations")
write_csv(sirene, "data/sirene_creations_by_municipality_year.csv")
head(sirene)
```


## DVF

```{r}
read_dvf <- function(file) {
  read_csv(here("data", file),
           col_types = cols(INSEE_COM = col_character()),
           show_col_types = FALSE
           )
}

dvf <- bind_rows(read_dvf("dvf2019.csv"),
                 read_dvf("dvf2022.csv"),
                 read_dvf("dvf2023.csv")) |>
  select(INSEE_COM, Annee, Nb_mutations, PrixMoyen, Prixm2Moyen) |>
  rename(code_commune = INSEE_COM)
```

```{r}
dvf_wide <- dvf |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Annee,
              values_from = c(Nb_mutations, PrixMoyen, Prixm2Moyen))

nrow(dvf_wide)
ncol(dvf_wide)

sum(is.na(dvf_wide$Prixm2Moyen_2019))
sum(is.na(dvf_wide$Prixm2Moyen_2022))
sum(is.na(dvf_wide$Prixm2Moyen_2023))
```

```{r}
dvf_growth <- dvf_wide |>
  mutate(growth_19_22 = (Prixm2Moyen_2022 - Prixm2Moyen_2019) / Prixm2Moyen_2019 * 100,
         growth_19_23 = (Prixm2Moyen_2023 - Prixm2Moyen_2019) / Prixm2Moyen_2019 * 100,
         growth_22_23 = (Prixm2Moyen_2023 - Prixm2Moyen_2022) / Prixm2Moyen_2022 * 100)

sum(!is.na(dvf_growth$growth_19_22))
sum(!is.na(dvf_growth$growth_19_23))
sum(!is.na(dvf_growth$growth_22_23))

```

```{r}
summary(dvf_growth$growth_19_22)
summary(dvf_growth$growth_19_23)

```

```{r}
for (k in c(3, 5, 10)) {
  n_22 <- sum(dvf_growth$Nb_mutations_2019 >= k &
              dvf_growth$Nb_mutations_2022 >= k, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_23 <- sum(dvf_growth$Nb_mutations_2019 >= k &
              dvf_growth$Nb_mutations_2023 >= k, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("min", k, "sales: ", n_22, "communes (19-22), ", n_23, "communes (19-23)\n")
}

dvf_growth |>
  filter(Nb_mutations_2019 >= 5, Nb_mutations_2023 >= 5) |>
  pull(growth_19_23) |>
  summary()
```
